source_pages.raw_wikitext:
{{Infobox/Helmet Skin |rarity = ultimate |id = BLAZING_CRIMSON }} The '''Blazing Crimson Helmet Skin''' is an {{Ultimate}} [[Helmet Skin]] that could be purchased from a [[Fire Sale]]. == Obtaining == {{Fire Sale Obtaining|date = December 25, 2025|rarity=ultimate|gems_cost=1,800|stock=12,500}} == Usage == {{Helmet Skin Usage|applied = Crimson Helmet |applied2 = Aurora Helmet |applied3 = Terror Helmet |applied4 = Fervor Helmet |applied5 = Hollow Helmet|animated = yes|selectable_versions = 19|notes = {{Green|Features!}}
